entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: `@ end()` modifier requires query range context (use LowerAt)
entries.rationale: the query endpoints always lower via LowerAtRange with the request window, so range context is always present; plain Lower is reached only from the matcher-metadata path, which carries no @ modifiers. Re-verified after expHistogramRangeFnWindowed replaced expHistogramRateWindowed: it resolves its anchor from the same lowerRoot dispatch under the same entry points, so it adds no path that reaches this switch with an empty range context. lowerExpHistogramBareMatrix (cerberus issue #2548) is a new caller as of this change — the bare top-level range-vector selector over an exp-histogram metric — but it resolves its anchor from vs via this same anchorFromSelector under the identical LowerAt/LowerAtRange entry points its float-selector sibling lowerMatrixSelector already uses, so it adds no path that reaches this switch with an empty range context either.

entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: the parser yields only START / END / 0 in StartOrEnd. The claim is a property of the parser rather than of any caller, so the expanded histogram range-function caller set cannot bear on it. lowerExpHistogramBareMatrix (cerberus issue #2548) is a new caller as of this change, but the claim is still purely a parser property and does not depend on which caller supplies vs, so the new caller does not affect it either.

guard: default of switch vs.StartOrEnd over [case parser.START; case parser.END; case 0; default]
